test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In a circle of radius 42 cm, an arc subtends an angle of 60° at the center. Find the length of the arc.

(Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Radius(r) of circle = 42 cm

An arc subtends of angle at the center = 60°

**Formula Used:**

Length of an arc subtends an angle of θ° at centre = (2 π r) / 360° × θ°

**Calculation:**

The length of an arc subtends an angle of 60° at center = (2 π r) / 360° × 60°

⇒ (2 × 22/7 × 42)/6 cm

⇒ 44 cm 

**∴ The length of an arc is 44 cm.**
